event.quote: right ear has hurt since last night
event.text: Has she had any drainage from the ear, or does the pain change when she pulls on her earlobe or when you press on the area in front of her ear?
event.why: Drainage or tenderness with earlobe traction or tragal pressure would suggest acute otitis media versus otitis externa or other causes, changing the urgency and treatment approach.

event.text: You can care for her at home for now: ear pain since last night with no fever reported, breakfast eaten and school attended can reasonably be watched, using a simple comfort measure such as a warm cloth held against the ear. Seek urgent in-person assessment the same hour, without waiting for an appointment, if she develops swelling, redness or tenderness behind the ear, an ear pushed forward, drowsiness, stiff neck or seems very unwell. Arrange a same-day in-person check instead if she develops fever, ear discharge, worsening pain, or pain lasting beyond about two more days.
